content: Furthermore, intelligent automation, propelled by advancements in machine learning, has drastically enhanced predictive analytics, threat detection accuracy, and automated response capabilities, thereby modernizing traditional access control and intrusion detection frameworks [17] . Another defining trend among international competitors is the development and promotion of unified security ecosystems. Organizations and end-users are increasingly favoring comprehensive platforms that combine multiple security functions into a single, cohesive interface, thereby streamlining daily operations and significantly reducing systemic inefficiencies [19] . However, this rapid digitization has also elevated privacy concerns, particularly regarding pervasive video surveillance and data-driven security strategies [19] . The broader African cybersecurity market is currently experiencing a period of rapid expansion, driven by the continent's growing digital infrastructure and an escalating threat landscape. Forecasts indicate that the market across Africa will increase from USD 5.83 billion in 2026 to an estimated USD 31.07 billion by 2034, reflecting a robust Compound Annual Growth Rate of 20.43 percent [22] . This transition is fundamentally driven by the growing complexity of multi-dimensional cyber risks and the critical demand for streamlined operational approaches to enterprise defense. Integrated solutions are widely recognized as more efficient, significantly reducing the systemic fragmentation traditionally caused by deploying disparate niche tools, a priority that aligns with federal directives issued by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency in fiscal 2024 [21] . Within this integrated framework, network security remains a foundational product category, expected to hold 23.89 percent of the global market share in 2026, operating in tandem with the rapid growth and adoption of cloud application security frameworks . Global entities such as Fortinet underscore this trend by emphasizing integrated defenses that span across devices, applications, data centers, and network edges [24] . Similarly, key industry players including IBM, HCLTech, and F5 Networks are leading the application security sector by delivering holistic web application protection platforms [25] .
